blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) is seeking to strengthen its position in the global critical minerals supply chain by attracting greater investments, expanding regional production capabilities, and capturing more economic value from its mineral resources. In a declaration adopted during the 49th Asean Summit in Manila on Sunday, Asean leaders committed to developing an Asean Critical Minerals Strategy to guide cooperation across the minerals value chain. This includes exploration and extraction, processing, refining, manufacturing, and recycling. The move comes as critical minerals become increasingly important to industrial development, the global energy transition, digital transformation, and emerging […]...
